bullets.text: Designed an agentic clinical documentation pipeline: session audio streamed to Deepgram for ASR, chunked and indexed in Pinecone via Gemini text-embedding-004; RAG over prior session history autofills case sheet parameters and generates structured clinical notes.

Led extraction of the notification and worker service from the FastAPI monolith; architected 4-queue RQ system (default, messages, jobs, scheduled) with Redis health monitoring, 5-minute duplicate-task detection windows, and per-channel selective retry (FCM push, Exotel SMS, and SMTP independently tracked) — fully decoupling appointment lifecycle events and reminders from the synchronous request cycle.

Redesigned the appointment scheduling engine on PostgreSQL/Aurora for multi-clinic doctor-slot relationships and future date allocation, scaling the platform to providers across multiple physical locations.

Diagnosed and eliminated N+1 query bottlenecks via SQLAlchemy selectinload/joinedload eager-loading (10--100x speedup); added Redis caching with event-driven invalidation, Alembic migrations, and Redis health monitoring.
Rightsized ECS-on-EC2 fleets (Auto Scaling, Aurora read replicas), cutting AWS spend 25% while sustaining 99.9% uptime SLA; rolled out blue-green deployments to eliminate release downtime.

Architected end-to-end payment orchestration layer integrating Razorpay checkout and idempotent webhook verification; implemented AES-encrypted order secret management, clinic-scoped revenue attribution, and automated refund pipelines spanning appointment, assessment, membership, and pay-in-clinic payment flows.

Designed polyglot persistence layer spanning PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic migrations) for relational clinic and appointment data and MongoDB for high-velocity clinical document writes; enforced multi-tenant isolation through clinic-scoped access controls propagated across all API and DAO layers.

Engineered multi-channel patient communication stack: ReportLab PDF engine for cryptographically-signed prescriptions and referral documents; Firebase FCM push, WhatsApp Business (AiSensy), Exotel SMS, and SMTP email delivery fanned out asynchronously through the RQ worker service.

Revamped appointment reschedule orchestration across 10 modules (270+ LOC net addition) with cross-clinic slot validation and transactional session-continuity guarantees; rebuilt case sheet merge engine handling concurrent partial updates, prescription expiry propagation, and clinical history deduplication.

Designed MongoDB-backed doctor availability cache with compound indexes on doctor_id, cache_updated_at, is_active, and care-type compatibility flags (Psychiatry, Therapy, Couple/Family); explicit invalidation on slot mutations drives sub-50ms slot-query response times across 200+ concurrent API endpoints.

Integrated multi-provider video conferencing stack (Jitsi Meet, Zoom OAuth, VideoSDK) with server-side secure session-token generation and clinic-scoped access control; built WebSocket-powered in-app chat with real-time broadcast supporting concurrent multi-clinic sessions.

Top backend contributor across 900+ commits on a 94,000+ line Python codebase serving 200+ API endpoints, 35+ DAOs, and 25 database models; maintained multi-environment deployment pipeline via Bitbucket Pipelines with AWS SSM-based secret rotation and 25+ integration tests covering auth, payments, and scheduling flows.
Shipped 8+ production full-stack applications (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) for SMB clients as sole engineer; owned architecture, CI/CD, and deploy lifecycle across every engagement.
Contracted with Scale AI (Outlier) reviewing 200+ LLM-generated code solutions/week across Python, TypeScript, and Go; authored RLHF QA rubrics that drove a 12% lift on internal coding benchmarks.

Engineered adversarial Docker-based terminal benchmarks (AfterQuery) exposing multi-step reasoning gaps in SOTA models (Claude, GPT-4); built reproducible harnesses targeting tasks beyond current LLM capability.

Built a voice-first marketplace enabling farmers to procure agricultural supplies via collective group ordering; real-time pipeline streams PCM audio over WebSocket to AWS Transcribe (11 Indian languages), processes through GLM-4.7 Flash on Bedrock, and returns speech via Polly TTS --- Turborepo monorepo (Flutter, Next.js, Express/TypeScript) with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
RAG pipeline (Titan Embeddings v2 + Bedrock Knowledge Base) grounds crop-market responses in domain corpus, cutting hallucination on regional dialect queries.

Designed cluster-based procurement engine: farmers within 50km radius are aggregated for collective orders; Bayesian rating system ranks vendor bids; cluster state machine manages payment deadlines, reconciliation, and stale-cluster sweeping via Prisma/PostgreSQL.

Delivered Flutter mobile app for farmers with Riverpod state management, Dio/Retrofit HTTP layer, geolocation-based vendor discovery, in-app audio recording/playback, Firebase push notifications, and secure token storage.

bullets.text: Engineered dual-service MCP server (Spring Boot 3.5 + C++20 gRPC worker) exposing 4 Model Context Protocol tools (crawl_webpage, crawl_site, get_crawl_result, search_crawled_content) over Streamable HTTP and STDIO transports; Protobuf3 contract drives cross-language gRPC RPCs; site crawls run via @Async @Transactional Spring executor backed by Redis job queue and PostgreSQL persistence.

Implemented 3-tier URL security model: scheme + host validation → configurable domain allowlist/blocklist → RFC1918/loopback SSRF blocking (Java InetAddress resolution + C++ host literal regex); per-domain rate limiting, robots.txt enforcement, and regex-based exclusion patterns; gRPC client catches StatusRuntimeException and returns a graceful LLM-ready fallback document rather than propagating failures.

C++ pipeline strips scripts/styles/nav/cookie banners via regex before converting headings, lists, and code blocks to Markdown; every document prefixed with an UNTRUSTED blockquote in the converter itself; Elasticsearch indexed by URL-hash doc ID for idempotent re-crawls; field-boosted multi_match search (title×3, summary×2) with domain filter and highlighted snippets.

bullets.text: Engineered concurrent segmented HTTP download engine in Go: probes server range support via HEAD/GET fallback, splits files into configurable byte ranges across a goroutine worker pool (default 4 workers), persists progress as SHA256-keyed JSON task files, and validates ETag/Last-Modified on resume to detect server-side file changes; atomic temp-file rename prevents partial-write corruption.

Built BubbleTea terminal UI with per-segment progress bars and individual speed meters updated on a 250ms tick; pause/quit controls and color-coded status indicators --- progress callbacks decouple download logic from the UI layer via a Model-View-Update architecture.

Implemented concurrent same-host website mirroring with regex-based link extraction from HTML attributes and CSS url() rules, reconstructing the original directory structure locally; mirror benchmarking samples 4 MiB from each candidate and ranks by throughput; URL list mode supports batch downloads from text files with per-entry comment support.

Architected zero-server-storage P2P file transfer (Next.js 15 + PeerJS/WebRTC) with 256KB chunk batching, 3-concurrent-send pipeline, exponential retry-backoff (600ms delay, 3 retries), and ephemeral Redis share links (30-min TTL); handles arbitrarily large files with no cloud dependency.
Built transfer speed metrics and QR-code peer pairing; configured Turbopack for 5--10x faster dev rebuilds; deployed on Vercel's edge network with sub-500ms global cold-start.
